findings.message: .starcistacks/application-stacks.yaml: .starcistacks/brand/references/.gitkeep: .starcistacks/brand/references/.gitkeep is not part of the standard .starcistacks shape (application-stacks.yaml, images/<name>/ and <env>/{README.md, environment.json, infra, runtime/{config,env}, secrets/<slug>.enc.yaml}, and the seed levels seeds/ and <env>/seeds/ with their seeds.yaml, sql/, data/ and files/); move or delete it
.starcistacks/application-stacks.yaml: .starcistacks/brand: brand is not an environment the declaration admits; either the declaration admits it or it is not an environment
